hello.note: 'Peace' - the everyday hello, any time of day.

good_morning.note: Baş is 'good'; ş is sh, and î is a long ee.

good_evening.note: Ê is like the a in 'gate'.

goodbye.note: Said by the one leaving; x is a raspy kh.

how_are_you.note: To a group, or politely: hûn çawa ne.

thank_you.note: Spas dikim (spahs dee-KEEM) is 'I thank you'.

no_problem.note: 'On my eyes' - a warm reply; or ne xem e.

please.note: The zh sound is the s in 'measure'.

excuse_me.note: To get attention or pass by; to a group, biborin.

sorry.note: 'Forgive me'; x is raspy, like the ch in 'loch'.

yes.note: Belê (beh-LAY) is the more formal yes.

no.note: Nexêr (neh-KHAYR) is the more formal no.

delicious.note: 'Very tasty'; xweş e also works for food.

cheers.note: 'May it do you good' - said over drinks and food.
